enemies: Moss Guardian (level 84) without runes, weapons, or armour

st.t: Talk to Islwyn in Isafdar. He and Eluned are either north-east of the Tyras Camp or west of Lletya. If he's at neither place, hop worlds until he appears.

i: Teleport near to Elven Forest. Iorwerth camp teleport, Charter Ship to Port Tyras
Teleport to Baxtorian Falls. Skills necklace (Fishing Guild [1]), Games necklace (Barbarian Outpost [2])

st.t: If you don't have Glarial's pebble, get another from Golrie in the Tree Gnome Village Dungeon.

Bank everything besides the pebble, some potions, and some food. After, go use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's Tombstone east of Baxtorian Falls. Be prepared to fight a level 84 Moss Guardian bare-handed.
i: Teleport near to Elven Forest. Iorwerth camp teleport, Charter Ship to Port Tyras

st.t: Kill the Moss Guardian for a Consecration seed.

tr: Teleport to Baxtorian Falls. Skills necklace (Fishing Guild [1]), Games necklace (Barbarian Outpost [2])
Teleport near to Elven Forest. Iorwerth camp teleport, Charter Ship to Port Tyras
e: Moss Guardian (level 84) without runes, weapons, or armour

st.t: Board the log raft on the top of Baxtorian Falls.
Use a rope on the rock to the south.
Use a rope on the dead tree.
Search the northernmost crates in the east room for a key. Skip this if you already have the key.
Go through the doors from the west room.
Plant the consecrated seed anywhere in the room.
Return to Islwyn in Isafdar to finish the quest.
